ON THE 7 th OF NOVEMBER, 2023  WRIT PETITION No. 5500 of 2023  BETWEEN:-
 BHAVANIDEEN SINGH S/O SHRI DASARATH, AGED  ABOUT 53 YEARS, R/O TILIYA KAMACHH, DISTRICT  SIDHI (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI GUDDA SINGH UDDEY - ADVOCATE)
 AND  1. THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH  COLLECTOR SIDHI, DISTRICT SIDHI (MADHYA  PRADESH)
2 . REGIONAL DIRECTOR SANJAY TIGER RESERVE  SIDHI, DISTRICT SIDHI (MADHYA PRADESH)

3. DIVISIONAL FOREST OFFICER RANGE PONDI,
 DISTRICT SIDHI (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI ANUBHAV JAIN - GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE)
 This petition coming on for admission this day, th e   following:
 ORDER

Shri Gudda Singh Uddey, learned counsel for the petitioner prays for withdrawal of this petition with liberty to file reference under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

sentences.text: Accordingly, the petition is dismissed as withdrawn with the aforesaid liberty.
